### Read in Downloaded GEO counts:

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(tidyverse)
library(Orpheus)
seurat_obj = readRDS("../../Mouse_liver_data/liver_timecourse_seurat_object.Rds")

seurat_obj$seurat_clusters = seurat_obj$all_cell_types
```

show clustering:

```{r}
DimPlot(seurat_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "all_cell_types")
```

Add ZT information to Seurat object:

```{r}
table(seurat_obj$orig.ident)

matches <- stringr::str_match(seurat_obj$orig.ident , "ZT(\\d+)$")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
seurat_obj$ZT = ZT
VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = c("nCount_RNA"), group.by = "ZT")


table(seurat_obj$seurat_clusters, seurat_obj$orig.ident)
```

### What are reasonable params for my simulated data?

```{r}
s_obj = subset(seurat_obj, subset = all_cell_types %in% c("hepatocytes 1", "hepatocytes 2", "periportal hepatocytes", "pericentral hepatocytes"))

s_obj = prepare_seurat_for_orpheus(seurat_obj = s_obj, assay = "RNA")

tmp = calculate_orpheus_inputs(s_obj, groups_to_analyze = "hepatocytes 1", grouping_var = "seurat_clusters")


hep2 = tmp$`hepatocytes 1`
pb_mat = hep2[[1]]
var_mat = hep2[[2]]
counts = hep2[[3]]
dim(counts)

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "ZT(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])

vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
plot(log(means), log(vars))
theta_estimate = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
summary(theta_estimate$coarse_theta)
summary(means)

#Reasonable estimates for theta: 0.1 - 1.5
quantile(theta_estimate$coarse_theta, probs = c(0.05, .95))

#Reasonable range for gene means (G): 0.1 - 5
quantile(means, probs = c(0.05, .95))

cyclers = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat = pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")
cyclers$p_statistic = as.numeric(cyclers$p_statistic)

#What fraction of genes should I make rhythmic? 0.10
sig_cyclers = dplyr::filter(cyclers, p_statistic < 0.05)
sig_cyclers %>% nrow / nrow(cyclers)

#Reasonable range for cycling amplitude_ratio?: 0.15 - 0.75
quantile(as.numeric(sig_cyclers$amp_ratio), probs = c(0.05, 0.95))

```

### Now do Methods of Moments analysis (ORPHEUS)

Here we assign cells of each subject to one of two pseudoreplicates, we will do this 4 times and consider results found in all four folds.

```{r}
# s_obj = subset(seurat_obj, subset = all_cell_types %in% c("hepatocytes 1", "hepatocytes 2", "periportal hepatocytes", "pericentral hepatocytes"))
# 
# s_obj = prepare_seurat_for_orpheus(seurat_obj = s_obj, assay = "RNA")
# saveRDS(s_obj, file = "../../Mouse_liver_data/liver_timecourse_seurat_object_hepa_only_ORPHEUS_norm.Rds")
s_obj = readRDS("../../Mouse_liver_data/liver_timecourse_seurat_object_hepa_only_ORPHEUS_norm.Rds")

seeds <- c(1,2,3,4)
#Initialize an empty list to store all results
all_results_combined <- list()
for(i in seeds){
  message(paste("--- Running ORPHEUS with seed:", i, "---"))
    
    # returns a list like: list('CellTypeA' = ..., 'CellTypeB' = ...)
    results_one_seed <- calculate_orpheus_inputs(
      s_obj, 
      groups_to_analyze = unique(s_obj$seurat_clusters), 
      grouping_var = "seurat_clusters", 
      num_replicates = 2, 
      random_seed = i
    )
    
    # Modify the names to include the seed identifier
    # prevents name clashes when we combine the lists.
    original_names <- names(results_one_seed)
    new_names <- paste0(original_names, "_seed", i)
    names(results_one_seed) <- new_names
    
    # Append the newly named results to main list
    all_results_combined <- c(all_results_combined, results_one_seed)
}
# Check the names of the final combined list
print("Names of the final combined list:")
print(names(all_results_combined))
#save(all_results_combined, file = "mouse_liver_4_seeds_pb_var_counts_hepatocytes_only_normed_list.RData")
#######Load results from above #######
load("mouse_liver_4_seeds_pb_var_counts_hepatocytes_only_normed_list.RData")

cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in names(all_results_combined)){
  
print(paste("Analyzing", cell_type))


# tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cell_type, clip_sd = 15, normalize = T)
tmp = all_results_combined[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

#Variance of NB is var = mean + mean^2*theta
#rearrange to solve for theta = (var-mean)/mean^2
time_wise_theta_meas <- as.data.frame(mapply(function(v,m){(v-m)/m^2}, var_mat, pb_mat))
rownames(time_wise_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)
colnames(time_wise_theta_meas) = paste0(colnames(time_wise_theta_meas), "_theta_meas")
vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)


#Recover time in hours that sample was collected
matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "ZT(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])

if(length(unique(diff(ZT))[unique(diff(ZT)) != 0]) != 1 || length(unique(ZT)) < 6){
  print("Cell does not have time points suitable for analysis")
  next
}

#Call cosinor regression methods, where phases of variance wave are NOT fixed:
pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat)

all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols)
phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(acrophase_bulk) %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric

#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))

var_cyclers = var_cycling_fix_acro(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb)

input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    # mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= 0.5) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)


phi = calc_phi(pb_cycling, var_cyclers, cycling_p_thr = 0.05, bulk_amp_thr = 0.5)

output_cos_tmm = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)
output = merge(output_cos_tmm, time_wise_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
output = merge(output, agg_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)


local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) = cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))
}

```

### Combine lists from different celltypes/pseudoreplicates and plot

```{r}
cos_phis_tmm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))

# save(cos_phis_tmm, file = "~/Desktop/phis_2pr_4folds_unfilt_fixed_acro_hepa_normed.RData")
```

### Fold Averaging seeds

```{r}
load("figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/phis_2pr_4folds_unfilt_fixed_acro_hepa_normed.RData")

cos_phis_tmm_filt = filter(cos_phis_tmm, !is.nan(phi) & fund_mean_coeff >=0)
table(cos_phis_tmm_filt$Source)

phis_filt <- cos_phis_tmm_filt %>%
  separate(Source, into = c("cell", "seed"), sep = "_seed")

phis_consensus = phis_filt %>%
  group_by(cell, Row.names) %>%
  mutate(n_seeds = n_distinct(seed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_seeds == 4)

#Now phis_consensus has repeat genes for each "seed"
#gene count by cell type:
phis_consensus %>% group_by(cell) %>% summarize(n_genes = n_distinct(Row.names))

pval_cols = c("p_statistic", "double_freq_p_statistic")
phis_seed_avg <- phis_consensus %>%
  select(!contains("acrophase") & !contains("AIC") & !contains("BIC")) %>%
  group_by(cell, Row.names) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(pval_cols), max, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(where(is.numeric) & !all_of(pval_cols), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = T)),
    cell = first(cell),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) #%>% filter(cell %in% c("hepatocytes 1","hepatocytes 2", "pericentral hepatocytes", "periportal hepatocytes"))

#save(phis_seed_avg, file = "~/Desktop/phis_2pr_4folds_seed_avg_fixed_acro_hepa_normed.RData")
```

### Plotting

```{r}

jitter_width <- 0.15
jitter_seed <- 123 # A specific seed for reproducibility

custom_colors <- c("cholangiocytes" = "#883923", "endothelial cells 1" = "#E68613", "hepatocytes 1" = "#E69F00", "hepatocytes 2" = "#56B4E9", "kupffer cells" = "#00BFC4", "pericentral hepatocytes" = "#F8766D", "periportal hepatocytes" = "#F0E442")

liver_phi_boxplot_pseudorep = phis_seed_avg %>%
  filter(cell %in% c("hepatocytes 1", "hepatocytes 2", "pericentral hepatocytes", "periportal hepatocytes"))%>%
  ggplot( aes(x = cell,y =  phi*12/pi, fill = cell))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  theme_minimal()+
  xlab("Cell type")+
  ylab("Prediceted phase std. (hrs)")+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5,
      position = position_jitter(width = jitter_width, seed = jitter_seed)
   ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # The x-axis labels are sufficient
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1), # Angle labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),   # Increase legend title size
  )

ggsave("~/Desktop/liver_phi_boxplot_pseudorep.pdf", liver_phi_boxplot_pseudorep, device = "pdf", width = 8, heigh = 6)
```

### enrichR

```{r}
library(enrichR)
dbs <- c("MSigDB_Hallmark_2020", "KEGG_2019_Mouse", "KEGG_2021_Human", "WikiPathways_2024_Mouse", "Reactome_Pathways_2024")

run_enrichR = function(phi_df, dbs, prop = 0.5){
  websiteLive <- getOption("enrichR.live")
  
  top_frac = arrange(phi_df, phi) %>% slice_head(prop = prop) %>% select(Row.names) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
  bottom_frac = arrange(phi_df, phi) %>% slice_tail(prop = prop) %>% select(Row.names) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
  background = phi_df %>% select(Row.names) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
  if (websiteLive) {
      # Replace 'Rank' with 'Overlap' column, calculated with GMT files
      synchronized<- enrichr(top_frac, dbs, background = background, include_overlap = TRUE)
      synchronized_df = do.call(rbind, synchronized) %>% arrange(P.value)
      synchronized_df$group = "synch"
      unsynch <-enrichr(bottom_frac, dbs, background = background, include_overlap = TRUE)
      unsynch_df = do.call(rbind, unsynch) %>% arrange(P.value)
      unsynch_df$group = "unsynch"

     return(rbind(synchronized_df, unsynch_df))
  }
  
}

pathway_results = phis_seed_avg %>% group_by(cell) %>% group_modify(~run_enrichR(.x, dbs, prop = 0.5))

save(pathway_results, file ="~/Desktop/enrichR_top_and_bottom_half_phi_overrepresentation.RData")
```

### Repeat analysis above with slight change:

Above, I had 4 cell types and 4 folds. I ran cycling on pb and variance signals, kept only significant genes within a fold and cell type. At the end, I averaged parameters of genes that had a real phi in all folds.

Here, I will again have 4 cell types and 4 folds. I will run cycling on pb and variance signals (not worrying about a phi yet). Then genes that are significant in all 4 folds I will test in the full pseudobulk to get a phi estimate.

```{r}
#This pb and var list was created in the related analysis cell above.
load("mouse_liver_4_seeds_pb_var_counts_hepatocytes_only_normed_list.RData")

cluster_cyc_results = list()
for(cell_type in names(all_results_combined)){
  
print(paste("Analyzing", cell_type))

tmp = all_results_combined[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

#Recover time in hours that sample was collected
matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "ZT(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])

if(length(unique(diff(ZT))[unique(diff(ZT)) != 0]) != 1 || length(unique(ZT)) < 6){
  print("Cell does not have time points suitable for analysis")
  next
}

#Call cosinor regression methods, where phases of variance wave are NOT fixed:
pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat)

all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols)
phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(acrophase_bulk) %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric

var_cyclers = var_cycling_fix_acro(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb)

input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    # mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= 0.5) %>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

local_res =  list("tmm" = input_cos)
names(local_res) = cell_type
cluster_cyc_results <- append(cluster_cyc_results, list(local_res))
}

cluster_cyc_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_cyc_results), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_cyc_results[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_cyc_results[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))


cluster_cyc_df_filt = filter(cluster_cyc_df, fund_mean_coeff >=0)
table(cluster_cyc_df_filt$Source)

cell_seed_df <- cluster_cyc_df_filt %>%
  separate(Source, into = c("cell", "seed"), sep = "_seed")

genes_consensus = cell_seed_df %>%
  group_by(cell, Gene_Symbols) %>%
  mutate(n_seeds = n_distinct(seed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_seeds == 4)
```

```{r}
stopifnot(all.equal(rownames(var_mat), keep_genes))

 # Calculate phi parameters

}
```

### BootEJTK: repeat analysis with Bootejtk:

```{r}
#Load all_results_combined
load("mouse_liver_4_seeds_pb_var_counts_hepatocytes_only_normed_list.RData")


write_bootejtk <- function(df, outfile) {
  # Ensure data frame with GeneID as first column
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  df <- cbind(GeneID = rownames(df), df)
  
  # Extract timepoints
  timepoints <- colnames(df)[-1]   # skip GeneID
  timepoints_clean = str_remove(timepoints, "_rep[0-9]+")
  # BooteJTK requires a header like:
  # #    ZT0   ZT4  ZT8 ...
  header <- paste0("#\t", paste0(timepoints_clean, collapse = "\t"))
  
  # Write header
  writeLines(header, con = outfile)
  
  # Append table
  write.table(
    df,
    file       = outfile,
    append     = TRUE,
    quote      = FALSE,
    sep        = "\t",
    row.names  = FALSE,
    col.names  = FALSE,
    na         = "NA"
  )
}


write_all_bootejtk <- function(nested_list, outdir) {
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE)

  keep_list = c()
  # Determine which pb and var to keep based on if they have all timepoints
  for(i in 1:length(nested_list)){
    matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(nested_list[[i]][[1]]) , "ZT(\\d+)")
    ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
    if ( length(ZT)==12){
      if(all(ZT ==  rep(seq(3, 23, by = 4), each = 2))){
              keep_list = append(names(nested_list[i]), keep_list)
      }
  }
  }
  nested_list = nested_list[keep_list]
  all_tps = rep(seq(3, 23, by = 4), each = 2)
  
  for (name in names(nested_list)) {
    item <- nested_list[[name]]
    
    df1 <- item[[1]]
    matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(df1) , "ZT(\\d+)")
    ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
    stopifnot(ZT == all_tps)
    
    # Write dataframe to its own file
    outfile1 <- file.path(outdir, paste0(name, "_pb.txt"))

    write_bootejtk(df1, outfile1)
    # write_bootejtk(df2, outfile2)
  }
}
write_all_bootejtk(all_results_combined,"~/Desktop/mouse_liver_pb/")
```

### Prepare variance signal for eJTK

Now we need to isolate the 12-hr rhythms in variance to give to ejtk. Below I use regression to isolate the 12-hr components of variance 3 ways: modeling the variance without any priors about phase, and 2) using the phase from ejtk on bulk data, and 3) using y \~ pb residuals. In cases 1&2 I subtract out the contribution of variance from the 24-hr rhythm and non-rhythm.

```{r}
prepare_var_for_ejtk <- function(times, var_mat, mean_mat, pb_phase_file, pb_cycling_sig_cutoff = 0.05) {
   cat(paste("\nPreparing variance data for eJTK, input times must be regularly spaced, e.g. 0-24 and in hrs units\n"))
   if(length(setdiff(unique(diff(times)), 0)) != 1){
     stop("Error: times must be regularly spaced in hrs units")
   }
  `%do%` <- foreach::`%do%`
  pb_phases = read.delim(pb_phase_file, header=TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  
  sig_genes = dplyr::filter(pb_phases, as.numeric(GammaP)< pb_cycling_sig_cutoff)
  
  keep_genes = sig_genes$ID %>% unname %>% unlist
  var_mat = var_mat[keep_genes,]
  mean_mat = mean_mat[keep_genes,]
  
  # Transpose matrices to have subjects x genes
  var_data <- t(var_mat)
  means1 <- t(mean_mat)
  times_rads = times * pi/12
  # Initialize matrices to store the double freq signals, mean rhythms
  double_freq_mat_free <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  mean_rhythm_matrix_free <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))

  double_freq_mat_fixed <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  
  double_freq_mat_residual <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  # pb_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(var_data), ncol = nrow(var_data))
  # var_mesor_values <- numeric(ncol(var_data))  # Store var_mesor for each gene
  rownames(double_freq_mat_free) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(double_freq_mat_free) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(mean_rhythm_matrix_free) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(mean_rhythm_matrix_free) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(double_freq_mat_fixed) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(double_freq_mat_fixed) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  rownames(double_freq_mat_residual) <- colnames(var_data)  # Gene names
  colnames(double_freq_mat_residual) <- rownames(var_data)  # Subject names
  
  rm_rows = c()
  # Loop through genes to calculate the double-frequency component, mean rhythm, and pseudobulk rhythm
  for (gene_i in 1:ncol(var_data)){
    gene_symbol = colnames(var_data)[gene_i]
    ejtk_bulk_phase = pb_phases$PhaseMean[pb_phases$ID == gene_symbol]
    ejtk_bulk_phase_rads = ejtk_bulk_phase * pi / 12
    stopifnot(ejtk_bulk_phase_rads >= 0 & ejtk_bulk_phase_rads <= 2*pi)
    stopifnot(rlang::is_empty(ejtk_bulk_phase) == FALSE)
    
    gexp1 <- as.numeric(unlist(var_data[, gene_i]))
    m1 <- as.numeric(unlist(means1[, gene_i]))

    # Fit the variance model
    var_model_free <- lm(gexp1 ~ sin(2 *times_rads) + cos(2 * times_rads) + m1)
    design_matrix_free <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ sin(2 * times_rads) + cos(2 * times_rads) + m1)


    double_wave = cos(2 * (times_rads- pi/2 - ejtk_bulk_phase_rads))
    var_model_fixed = lm(gexp1 ~ double_wave + m1)
    design_matrix_fixed <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ double_wave + m1)
    
    var_model_residual = lm(gexp1 ~ m1)


    sv <- svd(design_matrix_free)$d
    sv2 <- svd(design_matrix_fixed)$d
    tol <- 1e-14
    rankX <- sum(sv > tol)
    rankX2 <- sum(sv2 > tol)
    full <- ncol(design_matrix_free)
    full2 <- ncol(design_matrix_fixed)

    if (rankX < full || rankX2 < full2) {
      # design matrix is rank-deficient -> at least one coef would be NA
      # message(paste("Skipping gene", gene_symbol, "due to rank-deficient design matrix"))
      rm_rows = append(gene_i, rm_rows)
    }

    if (var_model_free$coefficients[["m1"]] < 0 || var_model_fixed$coefficients[["m1"]] < 0 || var_model_residual$coefficients[["m1"]] < 0) {
      # If the coefficient for m1 is negative, skip this gene
      # message(paste("Skipping gene", colnames(var_data)[gene_i], "due to mean coefficient < 0 in variance model"))
    rm_rows = append(gene_i, rm_rows)

    } else {  
    # var_mesor <- mean(var_model_free$fitted.values)
    var_mesor_free <- mean(design_matrix_free[,-c(2, 3)] %*% var_model_free[["coefficients"]][-c(2,3)])
    var_mesor_fixed <- mean(design_matrix_fixed[,-2] %*% var_model_fixed[["coefficients"]][-2])
    # var_mesor_values[gene_i] <- var_mesor  # Store var_mesor for this gene

    # Calculate the double frequency signal (double-frequency component)
    circ <- gexp1 - design_matrix_free[, -c(2, 3)] %*% var_model_free[["coefficients"]][-c(2, 3)]
    double_freq_mat_free[gene_i, ] <- circ

    circ_fixed <- gexp1 - design_matrix_fixed[, -2] %*% var_model_fixed[["coefficients"]][-2]
    double_freq_mat_fixed[gene_i, ] <- circ_fixed
  
    double_freq_mat_residual[gene_i, ] <- var_model_residual$residuals
    
    # Calculate the mean rhythm
    mean_rhythm <- var_model_free$coefficients[["m1"]] * m1
    mean_rhythm_matrix_free[gene_i, ] <- mean_rhythm

    mean_rhythm_fixed <- var_model_fixed$coefficients[["m1"]] * m1
    mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed[gene_i, ] <- mean_rhythm_fixed

    # Calculate the pseudobulk rhythm (just m1)
    # pb_mat[gene_i, ] <- m1
    }
  }
  rm_rows = unique(rm_rows)
  rm_genes = rownames(double_freq_mat_free)[rm_rows]
  double_freq_mat_free = double_freq_mat_free[-rm_rows,]
  double_freq_mat_fixed = double_freq_mat_fixed[-rm_rows,]
  mean_rhythm_matrix_free = mean_rhythm_matrix_free[-rm_rows, ]
  mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed = mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed[-rm_rows,]
  double_freq_mat_residual = double_freq_mat_residual[-rm_rows,]
  
  
  return(list(double_freq_mat_free = double_freq_mat_free, double_freq_mat_fixed = double_freq_mat_fixed, fund_rhythm_matrix_free = mean_rhythm_matrix_free, fund_rhythm_matrix_fixed = mean_rhythm_matrix_fixed, double_freq_mat_residual = double_freq_mat_residual, rm_genes = rm_genes))
}
```

```{r}
plot_free_acrodiff_ejtk = function(cell_type, var_sig = 0.05){
  pb_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_liver/hepa_only_normed/mouse_liver_pb/ejtk_pb_results/",cell_type, "_pb_Vash__boot10-rep2_GammaP.txt")
  # var_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_SCN_var_nov26/", cell_type, "_double_freq_mat_free_Vash__boot10-rep4_GammaP.txt")
    var_path = paste0("~/Documents/eJTK/BooteJTK/mouse_liver/hepa_only_normed/mouse_liver_var/", cell_type, "_double_freq_mat_residual_Vash__boot10-rep4_GammaP.txt")

  pb_jtk_res = read.delim(pb_path, sep = "\t")
  var_jtk_res = read.delim(var_path, sep = "\t")

  merged_res = merge(pb_jtk_res, var_jtk_res, by = "ID", suffixes = c("_pb", "_var"))
```

```{r}
# cell_type_str = str_remove(cell_type, "/")
message("Looking at celltype: ", cell_type)
ejtk_sig_genes = consensus_unique %>% filter(cell == cell_type) %>% select(Gene) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
tmp = orpheus_inputs[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

stopifnot(all(ejtk_sig_genes %in% rownames(pb_mat)))

#Recover time in hours that sample was collected
matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
# print(ZT)


pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat = pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")


phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk)
var_mat = var_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
pb_mat = pb_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols))
stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == rownames(var_mat)))
phase_pb_num = phase_pb$acrophase_bulk %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric
#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))
var_cyclers = var_cycling_fix_acro(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb_num)

bulk_amp_thr = 0.5

input_cos = var_cyclers %>%
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    # filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    #mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_amp_thr) %>%
    filter(Gene_Symbols %in% ejtk_sig_genes) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")
    # filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

 # Calculate phi parameters
phi = input_cos %>%
        apply(., 1, function(row) {
            suppressWarnings(
                 find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
                 )
        }) %>%
        t %>%
        as.data.frame

colnames(phi) = c("G", "Ac", "theta", "phi")
output = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)

local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) =cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))


# cosine_vs_jtk = merge(vipgrp, input_cos, by.x = "Gene", by.y = 0)
# plot(cosine_vs_jtk$PhaseMean, cosine_vs_jtk$acrophase_bulk*12/pi)
# lines(c(0,100), c(0,100))
# plot(cosine_vs_jtk$PhaseMean12, cosine_vs_jtk$acrophase_bulk)
# lines(c(0,100), c(0,100))
# plot(cosine_vs_jtk$Max_Amp_pb/2, cosine_vs_jtk$amplitude_bulk)
# lines(c(0,100), c(0,100))
# plot(cosine_vs_jtk$Max_Amp_var/2, abs(cosine_vs_jtk$double_freq_amplitude))
# lines(c(0,100), c(0,100))
}
cos_phis_tmm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))


cos_phis_tmm_filt = filter(cos_phis_tmm, !is.nan(phi) & as.numeric(fund_mean_coeff) > 0)
table(cos_phis_tmm_filt$Source)


# save(cos_phis_tmm, file = "./figures/mouse_SCN/COMBAT_mouse_SCN_neuronSubtype_phis_EJTK_list_to_regression.RData")
jitter_width <- 0.15
jitter_seed <- 123 # A specific seed for reproducibility

custom_colors <- c("cholangiocytes" = "#883923", "endothelial cells 1" = "#E68613", "hepatocytes 1" = "#E69F00", "hepatocytes 2" = "#56B4E9", "kupffer cells" = "#00BFC4", "pericentral hepatocytes" = "#F8766D", "periportal hepatocytes" = "#F0E442")

liver_phi_boxplot = cos_phis_tmm_filt %>%
  filter(Source %in% c("hepatocytes 1", "hepatocytes 2", "pericentral hepatocytes", "periportal hepatocytes"))%>%
  ggplot( aes(x = Source,y =  phi*12/pi, fill = Source))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  theme_minimal()+
  xlab("Cell type")+
  ylab("Prediceted phase std. (hrs)")+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5,
      position = position_jitter(width = jitter_width, seed = jitter_seed)
   ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # The x-axis labels are sufficient
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1), # Angle labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),   # Increase legend title size
  )

# ggsave("./figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/bootEJTKgenes_to_cosinorParams/ejtk_targeted2hrWindows/boxplot_ejtkList_to_regression_FixedRegressionVarSignal_varPthr05.pdf", plot = liver_phi_boxplot, device = "pdf", width = 7, height = 5)

kruskal.test(phi ~ Source, data = cos_phis_tmm_filt)

# save(cos_phis_tmm, file = "./figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/bootEJTKgenes_to_cosinorParams/ejtk_targeted2hrWindows/phis_ejtkList_to_regression_FixedRegressionVarSignal_varPthr05.RData")

# How do these phis compare to the 2hr targeted results using "residuals" method?
load("./figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/bootEJTKgenes_to_cosinorParams/ejtk_targeted2hrWindows/phis_ejtkList_to_regression_FixedRegressionVarSignal_varPthr05.RData")
fixed_phis = cos_phis_tmm
load("./figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/bootEJTKgenes_to_cosinorParams/ejtk_targeted2hrWindows/phis_ejtkList_to_regression_residualsVarSignal_varPthr05.RData")
resid_phis = cos_phis_tmm

fixed_phis$cell_gene = paste0(fixed_phis$Source, fixed_phis$Row.names)
resid_phis$cell_gene = paste0(resid_phis$Source, resid_phis$Row.names)

x = list(fixed_targeted_list = fixed_phis$Row.names, resid_targeted_list = resid_phis$Row.names)
ggvenn::ggvenn(x)+ ggtitle("All genes (with Nan Phis)")

fixed_phis_filt = filter(fixed_phis, !is.na(phi))
resid_phis_filt = filter(resid_phis, !is.na(phi))

x = list(fixed_targeted_list = fixed_phis_filt$Row.names, resid_targeted_list = resid_phis_filt$Row.names)
ggvenn::ggvenn(x)+ ggtitle("Real Phi genes")
```

##### Cell Receptor plots

```{r}
s_obj =  seurat_obj

#I will take raw counts from seurat, pseudobulk them by cell type and individual, then tmm normalize with edgeR to logcpm, then provide those numebrs to gsva:
summed_cts = AggregateExpression(s_obj,
                           assays = "RNA", 
                           layers = "counts", 
                           group.by = c("seurat_clusters", "orig.ident"))
summed_cts = summed_cts$RNA

y <- DGEList(counts = summed_cts)
keep <- filterByExpr(y)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")
# Get log-transformed Counts Per Million (logCPM)
logcpm_pseudobulk <- cpm(y, log = T)


#Now, I only need a single, average expression value for each cell type, so I will take the average of the logcpm values above for each cell type:
celltypes <- sub("_.*", "", colnames(logcpm_pseudobulk))

celltype_avg_logcpm <- sapply(split(seq_along(celltypes), celltypes), function(idx) {
  rowMeans(logcpm_pseudobulk[, idx, drop = FALSE])
}) %>% as.data.frame

scn_receptors <- c("Nr3c1", "Adrb2", "Adrb3", "Mtnr1a", "Mtnr1b")
feeding_receptors <- c("Insr", "Igf1r","Gcgr")
nutrient_sensors <- c("Mtor", "Rps6kb1", "Eif4ebp1", "Prkaa1", "Prkaa2")

# Combine them into a single list for convenience
genes_to_test <- c(scn_receptors, feeding_receptors, nutrient_sensors)


# Reshape the data from "wide" to "long" for ggplot
avg_expression_long <- celltype_avg_logcpm %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%  # Convert gene names from rownames to a column
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,        # Pivot all columns except for the gene column
    names_to = "cell_type",     # The new column for the cell type names
    values_to = "avg_expression" # The new column for the expression values
  )

load("../examples_fixed_acrophase/figures/phis_2pr_4folds_seed_avg_fixed_acro.RData")


median_phi_by_cell <- phis_seed_avg %>%
  group_by(cell) %>%
  summarise(median_phi = median(phi*12/pi, na.rm = TRUE))

plot_df = left_join(avg_expression_long, median_phi_by_cell, by = join_by(cell_type == cell)) %>% filter(cell_type %in% c("hepatocytes 1","hepatocytes 2", "pericentral hepatocytes", "periportal hepatocytes") & gene %in% c( "Gcgr", "Insr", "Nr3c1"))

plot_df$gene <- factor(plot_df$gene, levels = c("Nr3c1", "Insr", "Gcgr"))

library(ggpubr)
custom_colors <- c("cholangiocytes" = "#883923", "endothelial cells 1" = "#E68613", "hepatocytes 1" = "#E69F00", "hepatocytes 2" = "#56B4E9", "kupffer cells" = "#00BFC4", "pericentral hepatocytes" = "#F8766D", "periportal hepatocytes" = "#F0E442")

faceted_correlation_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = avg_expression, y = median_phi)) +
  # Add the points for each cell type
  geom_point(aes(color = cell_type), size = 4, alpha = 0.8) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  # Add a linear regression line to visualize the trend in each facet
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  # Add non-overlapping labels for each point using the 'cell_type' column
  # This is the key to knowing which point is which cell type.
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = cell_type),color = "black", box.padding = 0.1, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 123) +
  # Add the Spearman correlation coefficient and p-value to each facet
  # Spearman is robust for small N (N=4).
  stat_cor(method = "spearman",  size = 4, label.x.npc = "middle", label.y.npc = 0.8) +
  # Create a separate plot for each gene
  facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_x", nrow = 4) +
  # --- Aesthetics and Labels ---
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between Receptor Expression and Cellular Synchrony",
    subtitle = "Each point represents a cell type (N=4). Spearman corr.",
    x = "Average gene expression (avg log cpm)",
    y = "Median phase dispersion (hrs)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase x-axis text size
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12)    # Increase legend title size
  )+guides(color = "none")     # remove fill legend

ggsave("~/Desktop/mouse_liver_receptor_v_phi.pdf",plot = faceted_correlation_plot, device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 4)

```

### Hepatocytes together (and causal pathway analysis)

Given that the phi estimates across hepatocytes are not significantly different, it doesn't make sense to look at correlations between cell type phis and cell type GSVA pathway scores. Here we do something similar to the AD data: Combine all hepatocytes together. Remove genes that are rhythmic. Run GSVA to get a pathway score for each subject. Stratify the subjects based on pathway score, run ORPHEUS for each pathway and see which pathways have significant differences in phi.

```{r}
#Read in combined counts, normalize with edgeR, compute the logcpm (which we will give to gsva). Run once, then read in for speed (that is why it is commented out).

library(GSVA)
library(msigdbr)
library(edgeR)
library(SeuratDisk)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(circular)

s_obj = readRDS("../../Mouse_liver_data/liver_timecourse_seurat_object_hepa_only_ORPHEUS_norm.Rds")

#First we will identify cycling genes in the hepatocyte population with pseudoreplicates:

s_obj$heps = "hepatocyte"

#Create Pseudobulk:
seeds <- c(1,2,3,4)
#Initialize an empty list to store all results
hepatocyte_pb_var <- list()
for(i in seeds){
  message(paste("--- Running ORPHEUS with seed:", i, "---"))
    
    # returns a list like: list('CellTypeA' = ..., 'CellTypeB' = ...)
    results_one_seed <- calculate_orpheus_inputs(
      s_obj, 
      groups_to_analyze = "hepatocyte", 
      grouping_var = "heps", 
      num_replicates = 2, 
      random_seed = i
    )
    
    # Modify the names to include the seed identifier
    # prevents name clashes when we combine the lists.
    original_names <- names(results_one_seed)
    new_names <- paste0(original_names, "_seed", i)
    names(results_one_seed) <- new_names
    
    # Append the newly named results to main list
    hepatocyte_pb_var <- c(hepatocyte_pb_var, results_one_seed)
}
# Check the names of the final combined list
print("Names of the final combined list:")
print(names(hepatocyte_pb_var))
# save(hepatocyte_pb_var, file = "~/Desktop/mouse_liver_4_seeds_pb_var_counts_hepatocytes_combined_list.RData")
#######Load results from above #######
load("./figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/pathway_analysis/hepa_rhythms_w_pseudoReps/mouse_liver_4_seeds_pb_var_counts_hepatocytes_combined_list.RData")


#for each pseudobulk and var (4 total), find pb and var rhythms
cluster_cyc_results = list()
pb_cyc_res = list()
for(cell_type in names(hepatocyte_pb_var)){
  
print(paste("Analyzing", cell_type))

tmp = hepatocyte_pb_var[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

#Recover time in hours that sample was collected
matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "ZT(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])

if(length(unique(diff(ZT))[unique(diff(ZT)) != 0]) != 1 || length(unique(ZT)) < 6){
  print("Cell does not have time points suitable for analysis")
  next
}

#Call cosinor regression methods, where phases of variance wave are NOT fixed:
pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")

all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols)
phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(acrophase_bulk) %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric

var_cyclers = var_cycling_fix_acro(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb, time_units = "hrs")

input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    # mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= 0.5) %>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

local_res =  list("tmm" = input_cos)
names(local_res) = cell_type
cluster_cyc_results <- append(cluster_cyc_results, list(local_res))

local_res2 = list(pb_cycling)
names(local_res2) =cell_type
pb_cyc_res <- append(pb_cyc_res, list(local_res2))
}

cluster_cyc_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_cyc_results), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_cyc_results[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_cyc_results[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))


cluster_cyc_df_filt = filter(cluster_cyc_df, fund_mean_coeff >=0)
table(cluster_cyc_df_filt$Source)

cell_seed_df <- cluster_cyc_df_filt %>%
  separate(Source, into = c("cell", "seed"), sep = "_seed")

genes_consensus = cell_seed_df %>%
  group_by(cell, Gene_Symbols) %>%
  mutate(n_seeds = n_distinct(seed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_seeds == 4)

hepa_combined_phi_estimates_2PR = genes_consensus
# save(hepa_combined_phi_estimates_2PR, file = "~/Desktop/hepa_combined_phi_estimates_2PseudoReps.RData")

gene_list <- genes_consensus %>%
 group_by(cell) %>%
 summarise(genes = list(unique(Gene_Symbols)), .groups = "drop") %>%
 deframe()

hepatocyte_combined_genes_to_test = gene_list[["hepatocyte"]]
# save(hepatocyte_combined_genes_to_test, file = "figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/pathway_analysis/hepatocyte_combined_genes_to_calc_phi_on.RData")

hepa_cyclers <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(pb_cyc_res), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- pb_cyc_res[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(pb_cyc_res[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
})) 
hepa_cyclers_filt = filter(hepa_cyclers, as.numeric(p_statistic) < 0.05)

hepa_cyclers_consensus  = hepa_cyclers_filt %>% 
  separate(Source, into = c("cell", "seed"), sep = "_seed")%>%
  group_by(cell, Gene_Symbols) %>%
  mutate(n_seeds = n_distinct(seed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_seeds == 4)%>%
 group_by(cell) %>%
 summarise(genes = list(unique(Gene_Symbols)), .groups = "drop") %>%
 deframe()

hepa_cyclers_consensus = hepa_cyclers_consensus[["hepatocyte"]]
# save(hepa_cyclers_consensus, file = "figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/pathway_analysis/hepatocyte_genes_cycling_all_4_folds_hepatocyte_combined.RData")

```

#### Call GSVA to score cells, pseudobulk them by stratified score

here I scores cells with GSVA, then stratify them into quartiles or tertiles.

```{r}
#convert logged PB counts to a df
df_log_counts = as.data.frame(log_counts)

#select the non-rhythmic genes
tmm_non_rhythmic = df_log_counts[hepa_non_cyclers,]
  
tmm_non_rhythmic_matrix = as.matrix(tmm_non_rhythmic)

#Call GSVA, ranking CTL subjects by pathway score for all pathways
# gsva_res_mat = gsva(tmm_non_rhythmic_matrix, genesets_list, min.sz = 30)
gsva_res_mat = gsva(tmm_non_rhythmic_matrix, genesets_list, min.sz = 1)

# save(gsva_res_mat, file = "~/Desktop/mouse_liver_hepatocytes_gsva_cell_hallmark.RData")
##########################
# LOAD cell GSVA results #
load("figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/pathway_analysis/mouse_liver_hepatocytes_gsva_cell_hallmark_minSize30.RData")
###########################
gsva_res = gsva_res_mat %>% as.data.frame

##QUARTILES
# pathway_groups <- t(apply(gsva_res, 1, function(scores) {
#   qs <- quantile(scores, probs = c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
#   cut(scores, breaks = qs, include.lowest = TRUE,
#       labels = c("Q1_low", "Q2_midlow", "Q3_midhigh", "Q4_high"))
# }))
#TERTILES
pathway_groups <- t(apply(gsva_res, 1, function(scores) {
    bins <- ntile(scores, 3)
  factor(
    bins,
    levels = 1:3,
    labels = c("T1_low", "T2_mid", "T3_high")
  )
}))
# pathway_groups <- t(apply(gsva_res, 1, function(scores) {
#     bins <- ntile(scores, 2)
#   factor(
#     bins,
#     levels = 1:2,
#     labels = c("low", "high")
#   )
# }))

dimnames(pathway_groups) <- list(rownames(gsva_res), colnames(gsva_res))

stopifnot(all(colnames(pathway_groups) == colnames(s_obj)))
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Loop through all the pathways and create pb and variance matrices for each,
#We will store these so I only have to do it once.

pb_var_list = list()
for(i in 1:nrow(pathway_groups)){

pathway_name = rownames(pathway_groups)[i]
message("Analyzing ", pathway_name)


score <- gsva_res[i, ] %>% unname %>% unlist

# Check depth dependence
cor1 = cor(score, s_obj$nCount_RNA,   use = "complete.obs")
cor2 = cor(score, s_obj$nFeature_RNA, use = "complete.obs")
print(cor1)
print(cor2)

cell_strat = pathway_groups[i, ]
stopifnot(all(colnames(pathway_groups) == colnames(s_obj)))

cell_times = str_extract(s_obj$orig.ident, "[0-9]+$") %>% as.numeric

### rhythmicity of pathway scores
cell_times_rad = cell_times * pi/12

mean_score_by_t <- tibble(s = score, t = cell_times_rad) %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarise(mean_s = mean(s), .groups = "drop")

partial_model = lm(mean_s ~ 1, data = mean_score_by_t)
full_model = lm(mean_s ~ sin(t) + cos(t), data = mean_score_by_t)
anova_results = anova(partial_model, full_model)
if(anova_results$`Pr(>F)`[2] < 0.05){
   message(pathway_name , " nested cosinor F test < 0.05, skipping.")
   next # Skips the rest of the current iteration
}
```

```{r}
#Loop through all the pathways and create pb and variance matrices for each,

pb_var_list = list()
for(i in 1:nrow(pathway_groups)){

pathway_name = rownames(pathway_groups)[i]
message("Analyzing ", pathway_name)


score <- gsva_res[i, ] %>% unname %>% unlist

# Check depth dependence
cor1 = cor(score, s_obj$nCount_RNA)
cor2 = cor(score, s_obj$nFeature_RNA)
print(cor1)
print(cor2)

cell_strat = pathway_groups[i, ]
stopifnot(all(colnames(pathway_groups) == colnames(s_obj)))

cell_times = str_extract(s_obj$orig.ident, "[0-9]+$") %>% as.numeric

### rhythmicity of pathway scores
cell_times_rad = cell_times * pi/12

mean_score_by_t <- tibble(s = score, t = cell_times_rad) %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  summarise(mean_s = mean(s), .groups = "drop")

partial_model = lm(mean_s ~ 1, data = mean_score_by_t)
full_model = lm(mean_s ~ sin(t) + cos(t), data = mean_score_by_t)
anova_results = anova(partial_model, full_model)
if(anova_results$`Pr(>F)`[2] < 0.05){
   message(pathway_name , " nested cosinor F test < 0.05, skipping.")
   next # Skips the rest of the current iteration
}
```

#### Calc phi in combined hepatocyte pseudobulk and variance for in each pathway:

```{r}
#Now read in the genes we will calc phis in:
load("figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/pathway_analysis/hepa_rhythms_w_pseudoReps/hepatocyte_combined_genes_to_calc_phi_on.RData")

# load("figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/pathway_analysis/hepa_rhythms_NO_pseudoReps/hepatocyte_combined_genes_to_calc_phi_on.RData")

keep_genes = hepatocyte_combined_genes_to_test
#Now for each pathway, we look at the high, mid, and low groups:
phi_outputs = list()
stat_tests = list()
for(pathway_name in names(pb_var_list)){

orpheus_input_i = pb_var_list[[pathway_name]]

cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in names(orpheus_input_i)){
print(paste("Analyzing condition", cell_type))
tmp = orpheus_input_i[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
times = colnames(pb_mat) %>% str_extract(., "[0-9]+$") %>% as.numeric


pb_mat_keep = pb_mat[keep_genes, ]
var_mat_keep = var_mat[keep_genes, ]

stopifnot(all.equal(rownames(pb_mat_keep), rownames(var_mat_keep)))

pb_cycling_group = is_cycling(times, pb_mat_keep, time_units = "hrs")
# write.table(pb_cycling_custom, paste0("~/Desktop/pb_cycling_results_",cell_type, ".csv" ), sep = ",", row.names = F)

stopifnot(all.equal(pb_cycling_group$Gene_Symbols , rownames(var_mat_keep)))
pb_phases_group = as.numeric(pb_cycling_group$acrophase_bulk)

var_cyclers_group = var_cycling_fix_acro(times, var_mat = var_mat_keep, mean_mat = pb_mat_keep, phase_pb = pb_phases_group, time_units = "hrs")


input_cos_group = var_cyclers_group %>%
    left_join(pb_cycling_group, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix = c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    # filter(BHQ_pb < 0.1 & amp_ratio >= 0.2) %>%
    # mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk,  everything()) %>%
    filter(Gene_Symbols %in% keep_genes) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")
    # filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_thr_cutoff) %>%
    # column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    # filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

# Calculate phi parameters
phi_group = input_cos_group %>%
    apply(., 1, function(row) {
        suppressWarnings(
             Orpheus::find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
             )
    }) %>%
    t %>%
    as.data.frame
colnames(phi_group) = c("G", "Ac", "theta", "phi")

output_group = merge(phi_group, input_cos_group, by = 0)

local_res =  list("tmm" = output_group)
names(local_res) = cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))
}

#Combine 'low' and 'high' groups
phi_results_i <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))

#----- plotting ------
jitter_width <- 0.15
jitter_seed <- 123 # A specific seed for reproducibility
# color_palette <- c("T1_low" = "#66c5cc", "T2_mid" = "#F6CF71", "T3_high" = "#f89c74")
color_palette <- c("Q1_low" = "#66c5cc", "Q2_midlow" = "#F6CF71", "Q3_midhigh" = "#f89c74", "Q4_high" = "#7f58af" )

k_test = kruskal.test(phi~Source, data = phi_results_i)
pairwise_w_test = pairwise.wilcox.test(phi_results_i$phi, phi_results_i$Source, p.adjust.method = "BH")

# my_comparisons <- list(
#   c("T1_low", "T2_mid"),
#   c("T1_low", "T3_high"),
#   c("T2_mid", "T3_high")
# )

# Create the plot
p <- ggplot(phi_results_i, aes(x = Source, y = phi*12/pi, fill = Source)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(
  aes(x = Source, y = phi*12/pi),
  alpha = 0.4,
  position = position_jitter(width = jitter_width, seed = jitter_seed)
  ) +
  # Manually set the colors for fill and color aesthetics
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) +
  #Significance bar
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test") +
  # stat_compare_means(
  #   comparisons = my_comparisons,
  #   method = "wilcox.test",
  #   p.adjust.method = "BH"
  # )+
  # Add labels and a title
  labs(
    title = pathway_name,
    y = "Phase Dispersion (hrs)",
    x = "Pathway stratification"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # The x-axis labels are sufficient
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1), # Angle labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),   # Increase legend title size
  )+
  ylim(c(0,8))
#print(p)
ggsave(paste0("~/Desktop/mouse_liver_hepatocytes_pathways/phi_boxplot",pathway_name,".pdf"),p, device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 5 )

phi_output_i =  list("tmm" = phi_results_i)
names(phi_output_i) = pathway_name
phi_outputs <- append(phi_outputs, phi_output_i)

tests = list( list("kruskal" = k_test, "pairwise.wilcox" = pairwise_w_test))
names(tests) = pathway_name
stat_tests <- append(stat_tests, tests)
}

all_pathway_phis_df <- imap_dfr(phi_outputs, ~ mutate(.x, Source = .y))


save(phi_outputs, file = "~/Desktop/mouse_liver_hepatocytes_pathways/mouse_liver_hepatocytes_pathway_phis.RData")
save(all_pathway_phis_df, file = "~/Desktop/mouse_liver_hepatocytes_pathways/mouse_liver_hepatocytes_pathway_phis_df.RData")

kruskal_pvals <- sapply(stat_tests, function(x) x[["kruskal"]][["p.value"]])
kruskal.df = data.frame("pval" = kruskal_pvals, "BHQ" = p.adjust(kruskal_pvals, method = "BH"))
save(kruskal.df, file = "~/Desktop/mouse_liver_hepatocytes_pathways/kruskal_df.RData")
save(stat_tests, file = "~/Desktop/mouse_liver_hepatocytes_pathways_test.RData")
```

### Calc phi of hepatocytes combined

```{r}

load("figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/pathway_analysis/hepa_rhythms_w_pseudoReps/hepatocyte_combined_genes_to_calc_phi_on.RData")

keep_genes = hepatocyte_combined_genes_to_test

orpheus_input_all_hepas = calculate_orpheus_inputs(s_obj, groups_to_analyze = c("hepatocyte"), grouping_var = "heps", assay_to_use = "ORPHEUS_norm")

tmp = orpheus_input_all_hepas[["hepatocyte"]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
times = colnames(pb_mat) %>% str_extract(., "[0-9]+$") %>% as.numeric


pb_mat_keep = pb_mat[keep_genes, ]
var_mat_keep = var_mat[keep_genes, ]

stopifnot(all.equal(rownames(pb_mat_keep), rownames(var_mat_keep)))

pb_cycling_group = is_cycling(times, pb_mat_keep, time_units = "hrs")

stopifnot(all.equal(pb_cycling_group$Gene_Symbols , rownames(var_mat_keep)))
pb_phases_group = as.numeric(pb_cycling_group$acrophase_bulk)

var_cyclers_group = var_cycling_fix_acro(times, var_mat = var_mat_keep, mean_mat = pb_mat_keep, phase_pb = pb_phases_group, time_units = "hrs")


input_cos_group = var_cyclers_group %>%
    left_join(pb_cycling_group, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix = c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    # filter(BHQ_pb < 0.1 & amp_ratio >= 0.2) %>%
    # mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk,  everything()) %>%
    filter(Gene_Symbols %in% keep_genes) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")
    # filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_thr_cutoff) %>%
    # column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    # filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

# Calculate phi parameters
phi_group = input_cos_group %>%
    apply(., 1, function(row) {
        suppressWarnings(
             Orpheus::find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
             )
    }) %>%
    t %>%
    as.data.frame
colnames(phi_group) = c("G", "Ac", "theta", "phi")

hepa_combined_phi_df = merge(phi_group, input_cos_group, by = 0)
# save(hepa_combined_phi_df, file = "figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/phis_for_hepatocytes_combined/hepa_combined_phi_estimates_unfilt.RData")

hepa_combined_phi_df_filt = filter(hepa_combined_phi_df, !is.na(phi) & as.numeric(fund_mean_coeff) > 0)
# save(hepa_combined_phi_df_filt, file = "figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/phis_for_hepatocytes_combined/hepa_combined_phi_estimates_filt.RData")
```

### Pathway analysis within hepatocytes combined (not causal)

```{r}

load("figures/mouse_liver/norming_w_hepatocyte_cells/phis_for_hepatocytes_combined/hepa_combined_phi_estimates_filt.RData")

library(enrichR)
dbs <- c("MSigDB_Hallmark_2020", "KEGG_2019_Mouse", "KEGG_2021_Human", "WikiPathways_2024_Mouse", "Reactome_Pathways_2024")

run_enrichR = function(phi_df, dbs, prop = 0.5){
  websiteLive <- getOption("enrichR.live")
  
  top_frac = arrange(phi_df, phi) %>% slice_head(prop = prop) %>% select(Row.names) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
  bottom_frac = arrange(phi_df, phi) %>% slice_tail(prop = prop) %>% select(Row.names) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
  background = phi_df %>% select(Row.names) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
  if (websiteLive) {
      # Replace 'Rank' with 'Overlap' column, calculated with GMT files
      synchronized<- enrichr(top_frac, dbs, background = background, include_overlap = TRUE)
      synchronized_df = do.call(rbind, synchronized) %>% arrange(P.value)
      synchronized_df$group = "synch"
      unsynch <-enrichr(bottom_frac, dbs, background = background, include_overlap = TRUE)
      unsynch_df = do.call(rbind, unsynch) %>% arrange(P.value)
      unsynch_df$group = "unsynch"

     return(rbind(synchronized_df, unsynch_df))
  }
  
}

pathway_results = run_enrichR(hepa_combined_phi_df_filt, dbs = dbs, prop = 0.5)
```

```{r}
    results_one_seed <- calculate_orpheus_inputs(

      groups_to_analyze = "1", 
      grouping_var = "hepa", 
      num_replicates = 2, 
      random_seed = i
    )
    
    # Modify the names to include the seed identifier
    # prevents name clashes when we combine the lists.
    original_names <- names(results_one_seed)
    new_names <- paste0(original_names, "_seed", i)
    names(results_one_seed) <- new_names
    
    # Append the newly named results to main list
    all_results_combined <- c(all_results_combined, results_one_seed)

# Check the names of the final combined list

var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

#Variance of NB is var = mean + mean^2*theta
#rearrange to solve for theta = (var-mean)/mean^2
time_wise_theta_meas <- as.data.frame(mapply(function(v,m){(v-m)/m^2}, var_mat, pb_mat))
rownames(time_wise_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)
colnames(time_wise_theta_meas) = paste0(colnames(time_wise_theta_meas), "_theta_meas")
vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)


#Recover time in hours that sample was collected

    filter(amplitude_bulk >= 0.5) %>%

output_cos_tmm = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)
output = merge(output_cos_tmm, time_wise_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
output = merge(output, agg_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)


local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) = cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))
```

### Pathway analysis

```{r}
library(msigdbr)

mouse_reactome <- msigdbr(db_species = "MM", species = "Mus musculus", collection = "M2", subcollection = "CP:REACTOME")


pathway_strs = c("REACTOME_GLUCONEOGENESIS", "REACTOME_MITOCHONDRIAL_FATTY_ACID_BETA_OXIDATION", "REACTOME_UREA_CYCLE", "REACTOME_RESPIRATORY_ELECTRON_TRANSPORT", "REACTOME_METABOLISM_OF_LIPIDS", "REACTOME_GLUCOSE_METABOLISM", "REACTOME_CYTOCHROME_P450_ARRANGED_BY_SUBSTRATE_TYPE" )

mouse_hallmark <- msigdbr(db_species = "MM", species = "Mus musculus", collection = "MH")
  
pathway_strs = c("HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION", "HALLMARK_FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM", "HALLMARK_PEROXISOME", "HALLMARK_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES_PATHWAY", "HALLMARK_GLYCOLYSIS", "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA", "HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING", "HALLMARK_XENOBIOTIC_METABOLISM")

test_pathways = function(pathway_string, cell_type1, cell_type2){
  pathway <- mouse_hallmark %>%
  filter(gs_name == pathway_string) %>% select(gene_symbol) %>% unname %>% unlist
  if(length(pathway)==0){message("Error, pathway not found.");return()}
  
  tmp = dplyr::filter(phis_seed_avg, cell %in% c(cell_type1, cell_type2))
  if(length(table(tmp$cell)) != 2){message("Error with celltypes provided");return()}
  cell_types_pathways = dplyr::filter(tmp, Row.names %in% pathway)
  if(length(table(cell_types_pathways$cell)) != 2){message("Error, pathway not present for both cell types");return()}

  unpaired_test = wilcox.test(phi ~ cell, data = cell_types_pathways)
  return(unpaired_test)
  # cell_types_pathways_paired
  
}

test = sapply(pathway_strs, test_pathways, "periportal hepatocytes", "pericentral hepatocytes")
test = sapply(pathway_strs, test_pathways, "hepatocytes 1", "hepatocytes 2")
```

Write rnk files:

```{r}
# Create a directory to store the output files
dir.create("~/Desktop/mouse_liver_phi_rnk")

cos_phis_tmm_filt %>%
  group_split(Source) %>%                           # Split into a list by Source
  walk(~{
    # For each dataframe in the list...
    
    # Get the unique source name for the filename
    source_name <- .x$Source[1]
    
    # Construct the output filename
    filename <- file.path("~/Desktop/mouse_liver_phi_rnk/", paste0(source_name, "_sorted_phi.rnk"))
    
    # Arrange by phi, select the two columns, and write to CSV
    .x %>%
      arrange(phi) %>%
      select(Row.names, phi) %>%
      write.table(file = filename, 
                  row.names = FALSE,
                  col.names = FALSE,
                  sep = "\t",
                  quote = F)
      
    # Print a message to the console
    message(paste("Wrote file:", filename))
  })


```

```{r}
library(ggcorrplot)
cos_phis_tmm_filt %>%
    group_split(Source) %>%                           # Split into a list by Source
    walk(~{
        # For each dataframe in the list...
        
        # Get the unique source name for the filename
        source_name <- .x$Source[1]

        # Arrange by phi, select the two columns, and write to CSV
        .x %>%
            arrange(phi) %>%
            select(Ac_pred,G_pred,theta, phi) %>%
            cor() %>% ggcorrplot(.,title = source_name,  hc.order = F, type = "lower",
               lab = TRUE, lab_size = 3,
               colors = c("blue", "white", "red")) %>% print

        
    })
```
